It said protests call for Rama’s resignation amid allegations of corruption and opposition to a proposed coastal development linked to an investment firm founded by Jared Kushner. AP reported that Rama has ruled out resigning. These are attributed claims/reporting, not a court finding or a resignation notice. Source date: 2026-10-17.
